test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

The servants know the __secrets__ of the family they are working for.
solution: The correct answer is: "**Ins and outs**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Ins and outs**" means the detailed or inner workings of something. (किसी चीज़ की विस्तृत या आंतरिक कार्यप्रणाली) • **Example**: *Understanding the ins and outs of the new software is crucial for efficient usage in the office.* • It is appropriate in this sentence because the servants are familiar with the inner workings and secrets of the family they work for. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Latin and Greek**" means something that is difficult to understand because of its complexity or unfamiliarity. (कुछ ऐसा जो अपनी जटिलता या अपरिचितता के कारण समझना कठिन हो) • "**Hornet's nest**" means a situation that is likely to result in trouble or controversy. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसके परिणामस्वरूप परेशानी या विवाद होने की संभावना हो) • "**Long and short**" means the essence or summary of something. (किसी चीज़ का सार या सारांश) 35:T6af, The correct answer is: "**as journalist.**"
